jobs.title: Director of IT and Workplace
jobs.description:
The Role

We've grown to roughly 265 people working onsite from our Menlo Park headquarters, supported by a large network of remote U.S.-licensed clinicians â and part of the Series C is earmarked for acquisitions. The systems and the spaces holding all of that together were built for a much smaller company. We're hiring a Director of IT & Workplace to own them properly.

You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. You'll inherit a small, capable team and be accountable for leveling it up. You'll be the named owner for IT controls in our HIPAA and SOC 2 programs, you'll own the IT and workplace budget, and when we acquire a company, you'll be the one integrating it.

Our Environment

  • Identity and access: Okta for SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning.

  • Productivity: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, both in active use across the company.

  • Endpoints: a Mac-primary fleet with Windows machines alongside it, managed through MDM. VDIs included.

  • Internal systems: IRU, plus a growing portfolio of internal and third-party SaaS applications.

  • Workplace: a Palo Alto headquarters with conference room AV and access control, plus a distributed clinician and staff population.

What You'll Do

Strategy, budget, and team

  • Own a multi-year IT and workplace roadmap tied to the hiring plan, and bring it to leadership with clear tradeoffs and funding asks.

  • Own the IT and workplace operating and capital budget: forecast it, defend it in planning cycles, and continuously rationalize license, vendor, and facilities spend.

  • Lead, coach, and grow the existing team â set clear expectations, run honest performance conversations, hire as scope deepens, and build career paths that keep strong people.

  • Define and publish service levels for ticket response, uptime, onboarding readiness, and workplace turnaround, and report against them to the executive team.

Technology and infrastructure

  • Own the identity platform: SSO, MFA, automated joiner-mover-leaver provisioning in Okta, and access governance across every connected application.

  • Own the endpoint fleet and the SaaS portfolio â Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IRU, and a long tail of business applications â with enforced MDM baselines for encryption, patching, and configuration.

  • Own network and connectivity for the headquarters and the remote workforce, with redundancy appropriate to a company our customers depend on.

  • Replace manual provisioning, access reviews, and device setup with scripted, auditable workflows.

  • Lead major programs end to end: platform migrations, upgrades, office buildouts, and the IT and workplace integration of acquired companies.

Security, compliance, and risk

  • Serve as the accountable owner for IT controls in our HIPAA, SOC 2, and customer security review programs, including evidence collection and audit response.

  • Enforce least privilege across the environment and run recurring access certifications with documented outcomes.

  • Partner with Security on incident response and vulnerability remediation, and with Legal on data handling, retention, and discovery requests.

  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery for corporate systems â write the plans, test them, and fix what the tests expose.

  • Treat protected health information and confidential data with the care our customers and their patients expect. This is non-negotiable in everything we do.

Workplace and facilities

  • Own day-to-day operations of the headquarters, and lead space planning and buildouts against a hiring plan that keeps moving.

  • Manage physical security â access control and badging, visitor management, cameras, and emergency preparedness â aligned with our compliance obligations.

  • Own conference room and event AV, including all-hands and customer visits, to a standard where the technology is never the story.

  • Support remote clinicians and staff with reliable equipment logistics, home office standards, and consistent service regardless of location.

  • Manage facilities, AV, security, and food vendors, plus landlord and lease matters, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in IT, spanning hands-on administration or engineering and progressively senior ownership. You've done the work you'll now be leading.

  • 3+ years managing IT or workplace teams, including hiring, performance management, and developing people into bigger roles.

  • Proven ownership of an IT function through rapid growth. You've scaled systems and process ahead of headcount, not behind it.

  • Deep technical expertise across identity (Okta or comparable), Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, MDM at fleet scale, and corporate networking.

  • Experience as a named control owner in a regulated environment â HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST â including sitting across the table from auditors.

  • Budget ownership and vendor negotiation experience, with the financial fluency to frame a risk or a funding ask so a CFO can act on it.

  • Workplace or facilities exposure â buildouts, moves, physical security, or lease management â or a genuine appetite to own it and learn quickly.

  • Willingness to stay close to the work. This is a leadership role at a company where the director still unblocks a broken demo when it matters.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. We weigh demonstrated ability over credentials.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare, life sciences, or another environment handling sensitive personal data at scale.

  • IT integration of an acquisition, or standing up a function's first access governance or asset management program.

  • Automation depth (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and experience managing devices and infrastructure as code.

  • Certifications such as Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator, Jamf, CISM, CISSP, or ITIL.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. Weâre building the worldâs first healthcareâonly, safetyâfocused LLM â a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future. Hippocratic AI was coâfounded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

  • 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

  • Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

  • Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

  • Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

  • Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses

jobs.title: Technical Customer Support
jobs.description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

  • Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
  • Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

  • Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

  • Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

  • Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

  • Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
  • Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
  • The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

  • Contract type: full-time or part-time
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable

About the job

Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Because you will be running workshops and presenting directly tobusiness stakeholders and client leadership, excellent business English â spoken and written â is essential to this role.

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. jobs.description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. jobs.description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

jobs.description:
Über parasus

Die parasus GmbH ist ein zukunftsorientiertes Beratungsunternehmen, spezialisiert auf SAP-basierte Beschaffungslösungen und digitale Transformation. Bekannt für den innovativen Einsatz von Tools wie SAP S/4HANA, Ivalua und BeNeering, arbeitet parasus mit führenden Unternehmen branchenübergreifend zusammen, um Einkaufsprozesse zu optimieren und zu automatisieren.

Das Unternehmen zeichnet sich durch sein Engagement für Nachhaltigkeit, eine moderne Arbeitskultur und kontinuierliche Weiterbildung aus. Prozess- & Lösungsberatung im Einkauf

  • Analyse, Optimierung und Automatisierung von Einkaufsprozessen (P2P, S2C, MM-PUR)

  • Customizing und Erweiterungen in SAP Sourcing & Procurement, BeNeering und/oder Procure Ai für ein optimales Benutzererlebnis beim Kunden

  • Anforderungsanalyse sowie Key-User-Trainings

BTP & Integration

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von Side-by-Side-Erweiterungen auf der SAP BTP (z. B. CAP, Fiori elements)

  • Erstellung von Integrationskonzepten und Anbindung von SAP- und Drittsystemen über OData, IDoc, SOAP und REST mit der SAP Integration Suite

  • Du packst auch technisch selbst mit an: Schnittstellen analysieren, Fehler debuggen, kleinere Entwicklungen umsetzen

Kundenschnittstelle & Anforderungen

  • Bedarfsaufnahme, Scope-Abgrenzung und Priorisierung

Projektarbeit & Qualität

  • Vorbereitung, Moderation und Durchführung von Workshops mit Fachbereichen und IT

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Entwickler:innen und Architekt:innen als Brücke zwischen Fachbereich und Technik

  • Saubere, nachvollziehbare und audit-fähige Dokumentation; Weitergabe deines Wissens an Kolleg:innen

Dein Profil

Fachlich

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als SAP-Berater:in im Einkauf (SAP SRM, SAP SLC, ERP MM, SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement)

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im eProcurement / Guided Buying (Shopping Cart, Genehmigungsworkflows) – gerne auch aus vergangenen Projekten

Kommunikation & Arbeitsweise

  • Sicher im Kundenkontakt und im Stakeholder-Management zwischen Fachbereich und IT

  • Stärke darin, Business-Bedarf und technische Lösung verständlich zusammenzubringen

  • Remote-First: Du arbeitest flexibel im Homeoffice

jobs.title: Environment Artist
jobs.description:
About Techtive Games

Techtive Games is a Germany-based video game developer creating Ardem, an open-world survival game. Built by former modding veterans, the studio combines AA-level ambition with an independent mindset to push development practices forward and build immersive worlds built to be played, modified, and expanded.

We're looking for an Environment Artist to join our team as we move into full production on our debut game Ardem, an open world survival game developed in Unreal Engine 5.

In this role, your focus is asset production, with a strong emphasis on architecture and modularity. Our world artists build Ardem's world —> you create what they build it with: modular architecture kits, bespoke landmark structures, and the environmental assets that make the world feel believable and lived-in. You won't be doing level design yourself, but you need the instincts of someone who could — assets only work if they're made with world-building in mind. At Techtive, we believe in a creative workflow where everyone contributes to the final look and feel of the world. It's a team effort: you'll work closely with World Art, Tech Art, and 3D Art, using cutting-edge UE5 tech to push visuals to new heights.

One thing we care about a lot: we're hiring from our community. We want people who actually play survival games — not as market research, but because it's your genre. If you know from hundreds of hours in the genre why a base location feels right, why a ruin tells a story, or why clutter placement can make or break immersion, you already understand half the job. That's also why we'd love it if you share your Steam profile with your application — not as a gate, we're just genuinely curious where your gaming interests lie and how much they overlap with what we're building.

We value creativity, ownership, and personal growth. Rather than working through rigid ticket pipelines, our team members are encouraged to actively shape systems, improve workflows, and grow together not only on Ardem, but on future projects as well.

If you love building worlds players want to get lost in — and you've survived a few of them yourself — we'd love to hear from you.

Tasks

On a day to day basis, you will:

  • Create high-poly and low-poly models for environmental objects — with a clear focus on architecture: modular building kits, structures, and props

  • Overhaul and optimize our existing asset kits: consolidate materials, reduce poly counts, and bring everything to a consistent, performant standard

  • Create assets for bespoke landmark locations — the kind of places players remember

  • Design with modularity and reusability in mind, so our world artists can build more with less

  • Rework existing vegetation and natural assets to a cleaner, more maintainable standard where needed

  • Work from photo reference and concept art to hit a believable, grounded look

  • Produce clean, efficient UVs and game-ready assets that respect the technical limitations of a large open world

  • Work closely with World Art, Level Design, and Tech Art to ensure requirements are met

  • Help troubleshoot and fix problems as they arise, from a visual, technical, and production perspective

Requirements

  • Previous experience on professional game projects

  • A portfolio with clear examples of your own asset production — not just set dressing or kit-bashed scenes. On team pieces, tell us exactly which parts you made yourself; we do check.

  • Solid experience building modular asset kits, and a real understanding of how worlds are constructed from them

  • Strong modeling skills and experience in a major 3D package (Blender, Maya, 3ds Max)

  • Sculpting experience with software like ZBrush

  • Good understanding of the PBR material pipeline

  • Solid grasp of baking and texturing using the Substance Suite and Photoshop

  • Basic knowledge of shader creation

  • Ability to resolve issues from a visual, technical, and production perspective

  • Strong communication skills — you can articulate ideas and questions across departments, and give and receive constructive feedback

  • We’d appreciate a link to your Steam profile, so we can get a feel for where your interests lie and where they overlap with ours

  • Fluent spoken and written English

Bonus Skills

  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine 5

  • Knowledge of foliage creation

  • Experience with procedural workflows (e.g. Houdini)

  • Experience working on open world games

  • Experience working in an indie or small team environment

Working Model

  • Fully remote

  • Freelance, with a full time option for candidates based in Germany

  • Flexible working hours with a strong focus on ownership and trust

  • Direct collaboration within a small, focused team

Benefits

  • Work on Ardem, a highly anticipated survival game — and help set a new benchmark for the genre you love

  • Small team with high impact, results-driven mindset and fast decision-making

  • High ownership and creative freedom — shape the world, don't just fill tickets

  • Flexible working hours (results > green dots)

How We Hire

  1. First interview — We talk about Techtive, Ardem, and the role, and get a high-level picture of your skills and how you work.

  2. Art test — If the first conversation goes well, you'll receive a small art test: a basic brief with a few guidelines and some inspirational screenshots from Ardem. Everything you build should work as part of a larger environment — we're not looking for isolated beauty shots that would fall apart in an actual game world. There's no fixed deadline, but we'll ask you to track roughly where your time went.

  3. Second interview — We go through your art test together: your decisions, your process, and where you spent your time.

  4. Culture fit — The final conversation is less about craft and more about people: how you like to work, what you expect from a team, and whether we actually fit each other. We're a small, fully remote crew — who you are matters as much as what you build. The practical side (contract, conditions, start date) gets sorted here too.

We know an art test is a real time investment, and not everyone can afford that easily — we don't take it for granted. It's the fairest way we've found to judge actual craft over a polished portfolio, and it's the basis for a much better conversation in round two.

Die sogenannten Floating Storage and Regasification Units (FSRU) sind von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und damit kritische Infrastruktur mit hohem Risikopotenzial. Sie leiten daraus Empfehlungen für die Ausgestaltung unserer Marktangebote ab und entwickeln Tools zur systematischen Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit in Deutschland.

Sie entwickeln und leiten strategische Projekte zur Nutzung unsere Terminalstandorte. Aktuell begleiten sie beispielsweise eine europaweit ausgeschriebene Konzeptstudie, aus der konkrete Projekte hervorgehen sollen. Diese können thematisch von der synergetischen Nutzung mit Nachbarstandorten über die Umwandlung zu Grün-Terminals bis hin zum Aufbau von CO2-Terminals Umschlagsplätzen an unseren Terminals reichen. jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. 

You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. 

This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment.

  • Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work.

  • A systematic, process-oriented way of working.

  • The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems.

Tijdens deze hbo- of wo-afstudeerstage bij Risk Solutions, onderdeel van Centric, ga je aan de slag met een uitdagend vraagstuk waarin marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en procesoptimalisatie samenkomen.

Denk aan oplossingen en dienstverlening rondom kredietacceptatie, risicobeoordeling, Wwft, AML, KYC en fraudebeheersing. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over de markt, klanten, risico’s en wetgeving. De uitdaging is om deze kennis te vertalen naar duidelijke proposities en gerichte commerciële en marketingactiviteiten.

Jouw afstudeeropdracht

Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je kijkt waar het proces beter of efficiënter kan en werkt daarbij samen met collega’s uit onder andere Marketing, Sales, Business Consultancy, Compliance en Risk Management.

De centrale vraag tijdens jouw afstudeerstage is: Hoe kan Risk Solutions het marketing- en propositieproces zo inrichten dat nieuwe proposities met beperkte capaciteit sneller en consistenter in de markt worden gezet en de zichtbaarheid, vindbaarheid en commerciële opvolging worden verbeterd?

Je onderzoekt ook wat er in de markt speelt en hoe andere aanbieders hun oplossingen presenteren. Daarbij verdiep je je onder andere in kredietacceptatie, financiële risico’s, AML, Wwft, KYC en fraudepreventie. Je onderzoekt welke financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken bij klanten spelen, hoe organisaties daarmee omgaan en welke waarde verschillende oplossingen daarbij bieden. Ook kijk je naar wat belangrijk is voor bijvoorbeeld een Compliance Officer, Risk Manager, kredietmanager of directielid.

Daarnaast onderzoek je de zichtbaarheid van de verschillende proposities. Je kijkt hoe kanalen en middelen zoals de website, SEO, LinkedIn, klantcases, whitepapers, nieuwsbrieven, webinars en evenementen worden ingezet en waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Op basis van wat je in de praktijk tegenkomt, pas je de werkwijze aan. Zo ligt er aan het einde van je stage een aanpak die het team daarna zelf kan blijven gebruiken.

Je sluit je stage af met meer dan alleen een onderzoeksrapport. Je levert een geteste en praktische werkwijze op die het team daarna kan blijven gebruiken, inclusief hulpmiddelen, duidelijke afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om de resultaten te volgen.

jobs.title: Head of Legal @ AI Chip DeepTech Venture, Dresden / Berlin
jobs.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.


About the Venture

We build brain-inspired computing hardware designed to tackle problems that conventional computing handles badly or not at all. Our technology has its roots in leading European research and is now a commercial system, being deployed by research institutions, supercomputing centres and companies internationally.

We are a deep-tech company moving from research-led development into a much larger commercial operation. We are scaling our hardware deployments, expanding our international customer base and building the organisation and infrastructure to support the next phase of growth.

We recently closed fresh funding, are around 70 employees in size and based out of our Dresden HQ.

About the Role

This is our first legal hire.

Legal currently sits largely with the managing directors. Your mandate is to build the legal function, establish clear decision rights and create the infrastructure that allows the company to scale without unnecessary friction.

You will own legal end to end, from corporate and commercial through to export control, IP and product regulation. The remit is broad because we sell sophisticated, regulated hardware internationally and are moving faster than our processes have historically allowed.

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the legal and operational sides of the job: not simply answering questions, but building the frameworks, processes and decision-making structures that prevent the same questions from coming up repeatedly.

What you'll do

  • Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions.

  • Lead commercial contracting across hardware sales, licensing, research collaborations, cloud and service agreements, and NDAs. Build the templates and playbook so that standard cases can be handled efficiently.

  • Take ownership of export control and dual-use matters, including EU Dual-Use Regulation, German licensing requirements, US export-control exposure, sanctions and restricted-party screening.

  • Lead our cybersecurity and product compliance agenda, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and related incident-reporting and conformity requirements.

  • Cover product safety and market access for the hardware itself, including CE marking, EMC, RoHS, REACH and product liability.

  • Manage our IP portfolio: patents, freedom to operate, trade secrets, licensing, technology rights and trademarks.

  • Manage compliance obligations connected to public funding, including grant conditions, record keeping and audit readiness.

  • Work with People & Culture on employment matters, including contracts, terminations, employee participation structures, immigration. Data protection and GDPR sit here too.

  • Oversee open-source licence compliance and software supply-chain obligations together with engineering.

  • Build the delegation layer: signing authority, approval thresholds, decision rights and clear ownership, so that routine hiring, procurement and commercial decisions do not automatically converge on the managing directors.

  • Decide what we keep in house and what goes to external counsel, then manage those firms and the associated budget.

About You

You are comfortable being the only lawyer in the building, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a risk. You enjoy the operational side of legal work as much as the technical side.

You are direct, commercially minded and comfortable making judgement calls. You know where your own limits are and are happy to bring in specialists when the question warrants it.

  • Qualified German lawyer (Volljurist), with fluency in EU regulation.

  • In-house experience at a semiconductor, hardware or deep-tech company, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment rather than exclusively in a large corporate legal department is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with export control and dual-use questions in a business that actually ships internationally, including an understanding of the difference between licensing and per-transaction screening.

  • Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. You do not need to be the deepest expert in each area, but you need to know what good looks like and when to escalate.

  • You have built structure inside a company before: templates, approval frameworks, signing authority or something equivalent that outlived your involvement.

  • Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus.

  • German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin.

Why Join

You would be shaping the legal function of a company with direct access to the managing directors.

The subject matter is unusually interesting: brain-inspired computing, advanced hardware, international technology sales, export-controlled technology, research partnerships and a regulatory environment that is evolving in real time.

The work environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer a competitive salary with relocation support for the right person. If you want to build something meaningful rather than maintain something that already exists, this is that kind of role.

jobs.title: Technical Lead (Core Services)
jobs.description:
Technical Lead – Core Services

Build the Future of AI in Financial Services

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows.

We have been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland’s largest Series A rounds. Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re now scaling our team to meet that demand.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the core services that underpin Aveni’s platform.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role with responsibility for the architecture, quality and operational reliability of the foundations our product teams build upon. You’ll work across areas including client-data ingestion and preprocessing, CRM integrations and APIs, multi-tenancy, identity and authentication, and data lifecycle and retention.

You’ll lead the technical direction of a team of around six to seven engineers, remaining close to the code while making architectural decisions, setting engineering standards and helping other engineers grow.

Our platform supports regulated financial-services organisations, so reliability, security, auditability and data isolation aren’t afterthoughts — they’re fundamental to how we design and build.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Owning the technical architecture and direction of Aveni’s core platform services.

  • Designing and building scalable, event-driven services on AWS.

  • Developing and evolving our client-data ingestion capabilities, enabling new clients and data sources to be onboarded increasingly through configuration rather than bespoke engineering.

  • Building and maintaining APIs that give Aveni products a consistent way to consume client and CRM data.

  • Designing robust multi-tenant systems with strong data isolation, security and operational controls.

  • Leading our approach to data lifecycle management, including retention, deletion, residency and GDPR requirements.

  • Building resilient integrations with third-party platforms and APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, retries, reconciliation and failure recovery.

  • Making and documenting architectural decisions and representing Core Services in Architecture Review Board discussions.

  • Raising engineering standards across testing, observability, security, reliability and operational ownership.

  • Remaining hands-on with production code, primarily across Node.js and AWS.

  • Mentoring engineers through pairing, code reviews, design discussions and technical coaching.

  • Helping the team make effective use of AI-assisted engineering tools throughout the development lifecycle while maintaining strong engineering judgement and appropriate controls.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • Significant software engineering experience, with a strong track record of technical leadership and architectural decision-making.

  • Deep production experience with Node.js, particularly across backend, API and distributed systems.

  • Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native systems on AWS.

  • Experience building event-driven architectures and an understanding of the challenges that come with asynchronous distributed systems.

  • Experience designing production systems with complex multi-tenancy, data isolation or data lifecycle requirements.

  • Strong experience integrating with third-party APIs and designing for rate limits, partial failures, retries and reconciliation.

  • A strong understanding of reliability, observability, security and operational ownership.

  • Experience making architectural trade-offs and communicating technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.

  • A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards.

  • The ability and desire to remain hands-on while providing technical direction to a team.

Desirable

  • Production experience with Python alongside Node.js.

  • Experience with identity and access management technologies such as Auth0, AWS Cognito or similar.

  • Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0 and authentication/authorisation patterns.

  • Experience building software within financial services or another regulated environment.

  • Experience handling data residency, retention and GDPR erasure requirements at scale.

  • Experience contributing to Architecture Review Boards or similar technical governance forums.

  • Experience establishing or improving AI-assisted software engineering practices.

The Kind of Technical Lead We’re Looking For

We’re not looking for someone who has moved completely away from engineering.

You’ll still design systems, review code, solve difficult technical problems and contribute to production software. At the same time, you’ll create leverage by helping the engineers around you make better decisions and take greater ownership.

You’ll be comfortable asking questions before reaching for a solution, thinking through failure modes as carefully as the happy path, and balancing architectural quality with the realities of delivering software in a fast-growing business.

You don’t need to have used every AWS service or technology in our stack. What matters more is that you understand the underlying engineering problems, can explain the trade-offs behind your decisions, and have successfully operated the systems you’ve helped design.

Benefits at Aveni

What you’ll love:

  • Remote-first working across the UK

  • Work abroad policy

  • Co-working spaces available

  • 34 days holiday (including flexible bank holidays) and your birthday off

  • Company-wide off-sites

  • Optional Personal Development Plan

  • Flexible benefits platform

  • Protection essentials including Life Insurance, Income Protection, Critical Illness cover, and Pension (up to 5% matched employer contribution with optional increased contributions)

  • Private health and dental care

  • Potential share options

  • Enhanced family leave

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We’ve built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and its ability to drive positive change for the future of financial services, we’d love to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet 100% of requirements, we’d like to hear from you anyway if you believe you’d fit in. Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

jobs.title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $100k-$200k/yr (including equity)
jobs.description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today
