jobs.title: Content Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

About the Role

As Content Lead at Dex, you'll write and publish everything that carries our name.

You'll own Dex's channels: the website, social, email, our events programme and blog. You'll take a content strategy that already exists and turn it into a steady, high-quality output.

This is a job for someone who writes fast and well, and who thinks past the draft. The copy is half of it. The other half is knowing where a piece needs to land, what it needs to look like to get found, and what it should do to the reader once it does.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Growth, Design and Product.

You'll have real autonomy and very little bureaucracy.

What You'll Do

  • Own the channels. The publishing calendar across site, social, email and the blog is yours. You decide what runs, when, and in what order.

  • Write across every format. LinkedIn and X posts, campaign and event emails, landing pages, product and lifecycle copy, event pages and follow-ups, articles and explainers. A 90-word page and a 1,500-word argument in the same afternoon, both sounding like us.

  • Think in distribution, not just drafts. Every piece gets planned around where it will be read: why a piece lands on Hacker News and dies on LinkedIn, which newsletters and communities our audience already trusts.

  • Write for search and AI answers. We have a GEO and SEO spec built with our search partner: answer-first structure, extractable formatting, clean internal linking, author entity pages. You'll write to it and help us improve it.

  • Carry the events programme. Copy and collateral for our event series, before, during and after, and the follow-up sequences that turn attendance into something.

  • Work the numbers. Track performance and report back on the metrics that matter across our owned blog and organic social media channels.

  • Use AI properly. Research, outlining, structuring, first passes, repurposing, quality checks. We'll give you all the Claude tokens you can use. We will not ship anything that sounds like AI wrote it, and we'll ask you how you draw that line.

  • Guard the voice. You'll be the most frequent user of our tone of voice and audience research, and the person most responsible for whether it holds up in public.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing in-house or at an agency, ideally for a technical or developer audience, ideally in a start-up where you had to build the process as well as the output

  • Genuine range across formats and lengths, evidenced by a portfolio of published work

  • A real view on distribution: where our audience discovers, consumes and shares things, and what a piece needs to look like to survive that journey

  • Working knowledge of SEO and how AI search surfaces content, enough to write to a spec and challenge it

  • Fluent with AI tools across research, outlining and iteration, with judgement about where the machine stops and you start

  • Commercial literacy. You can connect a piece of content to an outcome and look beyond vanity metrics

  • Editorial judgement under your own steam. You can take a rough steer and come back with something better than the brief

  • A proactive communicator who works well without supervision and asks for what they need

Nice to Have

  • Any technical background, formal or self-taught

  • You've run a newsletter, blog or publication of your own

  • Experience marketing to engineers, developers or another audience that punishes fluff

  • Experience with content for events and communities

  • Basic design or motion skills, enough to get a social asset out without waiting

What this role isn't

Not a strategy job. The strategy exists and you're here to execute it, though you'll influence it constantly and we expect you to argue with it.

Not a pure writing job. Publishing, sequencing, formatting, distribution and measurement are all yours.

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

jobs.description:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to.

Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong.

What you will do:

  • Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner.

  • Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one.

  • Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast.

  • Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval.

  • Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest.

  • Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work.

  • Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.

  • Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us.

Who you are:

  • You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations.

  • You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check.

  • You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability.

  • You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call.

  • You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete.

  • You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster.

  • Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above.

Why join us now?

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

  • We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;

  • We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

jobs.title: (Senior) Privacy Manager - Governance & Legal (all genders)
jobs.description:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As our (Senior) Privacy Manager (all genders), you will further shape and build getolo's privacy organisation enabling us to further scale and expand our European business. You will take ownership of developing our privacy framework, from governance structure, processes and controls to tools and documentation, and bring it to life across the company. You will report to our Head of Governance & Legal, who will be your sparring partner and support you in implementing the relevant structures.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1–2 days per week in our Berlin office.

Requirements

Your Mission

Strengthening our privacy organisation

  • Taking getolo's privacy organization to the next level: furthering governance model, roles and responsibilities, policies, processes and controls
  • Define clear accountabilities between business teams, privacy and control functions (3 lines of defense), and establish the corresponding reporting and escalation lines
  • Reinforce a sustainable records of processing and data inventory that will keep pace with our products and data landscape going forward
  • Furthering privacy monitoring and controls, including KPIs and regular management reporting
  • Strengthening privacy awareness across the company through training and practical guidance

 

Privacy by design & technology

  • Embed privacy by design and by default into our product and software development lifecycle
  • Work with data and engineering teams on data architecture, retention and deletion concepts
  • Drive the implementation and automation of processes and privacy tools, e.g. DSR workflows and data mapping solutions

 

Day-to-day privacy advisory

  • Act as the first point of contact for data protection issues across business projects, ensuring compliance with the GDPR, BDSG, TDDDG and related regulations
  • Conduct and guide data protection impact assessments and risk assessments with our DPO at Zurich, and drive the mitigation of identified risks
  • Prepare, review and negotiate data processing agreements, international transfer mechanisms and privacy clauses
  • Oversee the handling of data subject requests and personal data breaches, including notification processes
  • Ensure the compliant processing of special categories of personal data, in particular health data
  • Assess AI use cases from a privacy perspective and support our AI inventory and AI risk assessments
  • Continuous Exchange with our DPO and her Privacy Team at Zurich

Governance & legal support

  • Prepare, review, and coordinate commercial contracts within established templates / frameworks, involving Group Legal where required
  • Contribute to the maintenance and accuracy of legal templates, registers, and internal guidance materials
  • Monitor and give advice on legislative and regulatory developments in data protection and digital regulation

Project Management

  • Apply structured project management methodologies to deliver governance & legal initiatives efficiently
  • Scope, plan, and execute cross-functional projects, ensuring stakeholder alignment and measurable outcomes
  • Champion process optimisation and continuous improvement in operational workflows, drawing on best practices from modern legal operations and project delivery models

What you will need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data protection, ideally in-house in a regulated, fast-paced or international environment
  • Proven experience in building or substantially developing a privacy organisation, not only operating an existing one
  • The ability to translate legal requirements into processes, controls and clear responsibilities, and familiarity with common governance and control models
  • Technical affinity and an understanding of software development, data flows, cloud environments and automation
  • Ideally a legal background, such as the First and Second State Examination or a degree as Wirtschaftsjurist (LL.B./LL.M.); we also welcome candidates with a different background and a strong privacy track record
  • Fluent in German and English

Personal attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach
  • Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager
  • High integrity, sound judgement, and commercial acumen
  • Comfortable operating in a lean, high-performance environment

What would make you stand out

  • A privacy certification (e.g. CIPP/E, CIPM)
  • Experience in the insurance sector or with insurance law

Benefits

Why getolo?

🌴 Salary & Vacation

  • Attractive fixed salary
  • Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st.

🧑‍💻 Mobility & Flexibility

  • Choose between a free Swapfiets bike, or a Berlin/Brandenburg ticket (“VBB - Jobticket”) or BVG “Deutschlandticket” subsidized by us
  • Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte
  • Work abroad in the EU for up to 60 days

🧘 Health

  • Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
  • Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

📚 Development

  • Learning Budget starting from 750 € per year
  • Regular (360 degree) feedback

🌍 Berlin Based, International Mindset

  • We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
  • Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

🧬 Values

  • Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:
    • #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes
    • #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction
    • #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions
    • #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive


🙌 And much more…

  • Legendary summer and winter parties 
  • Regular team events
  • Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform
  • Two Community Days per calendar year
  • Pet friendly office

Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

 

About getolo

Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives.
We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges.
getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. La nostra missione è semplice: offrire ai clienti cosmetici per unghie di livello professionale a prezzi accessibili. La bellezza di lusso non deve essere costosa!

Le tue responsabilità

  • Relazioni con gli Influencer (Italia): Ricerca, negoziazione e gestione delle partnership con beauty influencer e content creator italiani, dal briefing iniziale al completamento della campagna e al monitoraggio delle prestazioni.

  • Pianificazione e creazione di contenuti: Ideazione e creazione a 360° — pianificazione, ripresa e montaggio di contenuti video e fotografici originali e coinvoggenti, pensati specificamente per la community italiana.

  • Servizio clienti & Community Management: Gestione delle richieste dei clienti italiani tramite e-mail, ticket e social media con empatia, precisione e un approccio orientato alla risoluzione dei problemi, per garantire un'eccellente soddisfazione del cliente.

  • Localizzazione del mercato & E-Commerce: Supporto alla traduzione, localizzazione e ottimizzazione continua del nostro shop online italiano, garantendo testi e presentazioni di prodotto culturalmente in linea con il pubblico locale.

  • Supporto alle campagne & Presenza davanti alla telecamera: Assistenza durante i servizi fotografici/video di marketing e il lancio delle campagne, con la disponibilità e l'entusiasmo di metterti in gioco davanti alla telecamera per creare tutorial e reel autentici.

  • Gestione dei canali: Presa in carico progressiva, sia strategica che operativa, di specifici canali social (es. TikTok o Pinterest) per il mercato italiano.

Requisiti richiesti

  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana (obbligatorio): Eccellenti competenze di comunicazione scritta e verbale in italiano, con una naturale familiarità con il linguaggio del settore beauty e il tono di voce dei clienti.

  • Comunicazione inglese: Inglese fluido (lingua di lavoro aziendale); la conoscenza del tedesco o del francese costituisce un plus.

  • Orientamento al cliente e alla community: Passione per l'interazione con le persone, attitudine all'aiuto e pazienza nel gestire le richieste dei clienti.

  • Gusto creativo ed estetico: Forte senso per l'armonia visiva, l'estetica moderna del settore beauty, i trend attuali e la tipografia.

  • Disponibilità e impegno: Capacità di integrare agevolmente nella propria routine un orario di lavoro di 40 ore settimanali, nella sede di Berlino.

  • Affinità con il mondo dei cosmetici: Un'esperienza pratica o un forte interesse per le unghie in gel, lo smalto o la nail art rappresentano un grande vantaggio (saremo felici di insegnarti tutte le nozioni tecniche sul prodotto).

  • Prima esperienza: Precedenti stage o esperienze pratiche nel social media marketing, nell'influencer outreach o nel servizio clienti costituiscono un plus.

Cosa offriamo

  • Social & Marketing al centro: I nostri canali digitali sono fondamentali per la crescita del brand — il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto immediato e visibile sul mercato italiano.

  • Rapido percorso di apprendimento: Un ambiente dinamico e agile in cui potrai prendere l'iniziativa, testare le tue idee ed ampliare rapidamente le tue competenze.

  • Ambiente collaborativo: Un team affiatato e disponibile che ti supporterà durante l'onboarding e in ogni fase della tua crescita professionale.

  • Base solida da cui partire: Accesso all'esperienza e agli asset di account aziendali già avviati, con un seguito combinato di oltre 160.000 follower su Instagram e TikTok.

  • Ambiente di lavoro moderno: Stipendio competitivo, orari di lavoro flessibili, sconti per i dipendenti e attrezzatura di lavoro moderna.

  • Prospettive a lungo termine: Chiare opportunità di avanzamento di carriera e di inserimento a tempo indeterminato.

Come candidarsi

Ti sembra il ruolo giusto per te? Se hai motivazione, idee e voglia di far crescere il nostro brand in Italia, saremmo felicissimi di ricevere la tua candidatura! Anche se non soddisfi ancora tutti i requisiti indicati, ti incoraggiamo comunque a candidarti: premiamo la determinazione, la curiosità e un'attitudine positiva.

Invia il tuo CV, una breve lettera di presentazione e (se disponibili) i link al tuo portfolio, a lavori svolti o ai tuoi profili social.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance (all genders)
jobs.description:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As Vice President Finance (all genders), you will lead and further professionalise our global Finance function, ensuring the company has the financial transparency, processes, and steering mechanisms required to scale successfully.

This role combines strategic financial leadership with hands-on ownership of all core finance activities, including financial planning, controlling, accounting, treasury, payroll, tax, reporting, and finance operations. You will lead a growing team and continue the transformation of Finance from a scale-up function into a mature, globally operating business partner.

Beyond running the existing function, you will proactively identify future challenges and opportunities, helping leadership make well-informed decisions through robust planning, forecasting, business insights, and financial modeling. You will act as a trusted partner to the C-Level and leadership, and our corporate shareholder, ensuring Finance is not only a reporting function but a strategic driver of long-term success.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1-2 days per week working from our Berlin office.

Your Mission

Financial Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, develop, and inspire the Finance team across all functional areas.
  • Manage and support direct reports, including Accounting, Controlling, and Finance Operations.
  • Build organisational capabilities, processes, and structures required for the next stage of growth.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on ownership, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure appropriate resource planning and team development.

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Own the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes from a financial perspective.
  • Develop scalable planning structures and financial governance frameworks across all departments.
  • Ensure financial targets are translated into operational plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Continuously improve forecast quality and business visibility.
  • Support leadership with scenario planning and strategic decision-making.

Controlling & Business Partnering

  • Further develop financial controlling processes and management reporting.
  • Partner with department leaders to improve financial planning, cost transparency, and performance management.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Establish a culture of financial accountability throughout the organisation.
  • Drive improvements in cost tracking, resource planning, and investment prioritisation.

Financial Reporting & Accounting

  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting across all entities and markets.
  • Oversee accounting, payroll, tax, treasury, and financial operations.
  • Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and internal reporting requirements.
  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes.
  • Coordinate external audits and relevant financial reviews.

Corporate & Shareholder Finance

  • Serve as the primary financial interface to our corporate shareholder and relevant stakeholders.
  • Prepare board and shareholder reporting materials.
  • Support capital planning and long-term financial strategy.
  • Ensure transparency and professionalism in all financial communications.

Global Finance Operations

  • Own Finance processes across all markets.
  • Ensure consistency of financial standards and reporting across countries.
  • Support international expansion through scalable financial structures and processes.
  • Promote best-practice sharing and operational alignment across markets.

Finance Systems, Data & Automation

  • Drive the professionalisation and automation of Finance processes.
  • Improve the quality, availability, and utilisation of financial data.
  • Define requirements for Finance tooling, reporting, and workflow improvements.
  • Collaborate with Strategic Operations, Data, Product, and Engineering teams on automation initiatives.
  • Leverage technology and AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and decision quality.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously evaluate and improve Finance processes, controls, and governance structures with a strong focus on simplicity and ease of use.
  • Reduce manual effort through standardisation and automation.
  • Implement scalable operating models that support company growth.
  • Ensure Finance remains fit for purpose as organisational complexity increases.

Requirements

What You Need to Succeed

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Accounting, or related fields.
  • Proven leadership experience in a scale-up, high-growth, or international environment.
  • Strong background in financial planning, forecasting, and business partnering.
  • Experience building and professionalising Finance functions and processes.
  • Exposure to corporate structures and shareholder reporting environments.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, technology, or other regulated industries is beneficial.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Outstanding financial planning and modelling skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-making at leadership level.
  • High degree of ownership and proactiveness.
  • Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Strong understanding of finance systems, reporting structures, and process design.
  • Interest in automation, AI, and technology-enabled finance processes.

Languages:

  • Full professional fluency (written and spoken) in English and German

Benefits

Why getolo?

🌴 Salary & Vacation

  • Attractive fixed salary
  • Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st.

🧑‍💻 Mobility & Flexibility

  • Choose between a free Swapfiets bike, or a Berlin/Brandenburg ticket (“VBB - Jobticket”) or BVG “Deutschlandticket” subsidized by us
  • Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte
  • Work abroad in the EU for up to 60 days

🧘 Health

  • Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
  • Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

📚 Development

  • Learning Budget starting from 750 € per year
  • Regular (360 degree) feedback

🌍 Berlin Based, International Mindset

  • We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
  • Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

🧬 Values

  • Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:

  • #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes

  • #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction

  • #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions

  • #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive

🙌 And much more…

  • Legendary summer and winter parties
  • Regular team events
  • Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform
  • Two Community Days per calendar year
  • Pet friendly office

Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

About getolo

Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives.
We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges.
getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. With a team of around 300 employees, getolo is led by Daniel Gadea (CEO) and Laura Wulff (CGO). getolo is a partner of DA Direkt and part of the Zurich Group Germany.

getolo is an equal opportunity and diversity employer. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our team members, regardless of ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, limitations and talents of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

jobs.title: Working Student Marketing & Content (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unsere Mission

Neue Kunden zu gewinnen ist für viele kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen zeitaufwendig und teuer. selqo wurde gegründet, um genau diesen Unternehmen die Möglichkeit zu geben, planbar und kosteneffizient zu wachsen. Dafür entwickeln wir eine KI-basierte Plattform, mit der kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen automatisiert passende Zielkunden finden, sie persönlich ansprechen und nachfassen können, bis aus Kontakten neue Kunden werden.

Deine Aufgabe

Wie selqo im Markt wahrgenommen wird, entscheidet sich jetzt. Dafür suchen wir eine Werkstudentin oder einen Werkstudenten, die oder der Seite an Seite mit unserem Gründerteam die Marke selqo von Grund auf mitgestaltet: unsere Geschichte erzählt, Kundenerfolge sichtbar macht und unseren Auftritt auf LinkedIn und in Kampagnen prägt.

  • Du planst und schreibst LinkedIn-Beiträge für die Profile unserer Gründer und für die selqo-Unternehmensseite.

  • Du führst Interviews mit unseren Kunden und machst daraus überzeugende Case Studies.

  • Du gestaltest Grafiken, Karussells und kurze Videos für LinkedIn und unsere Werbekampagnen.

  • Du bereitest unsere Inhalte für Blog und Newsletter auf und baust beides Schritt für Schritt aus.

  • Du wertest aus, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und hilfst so, unsere Kommunikation weiterzuentwickeln.

Was diese Stelle besonders macht

  • Etwas Neues mitprägen: Mit selqo geben wir jedem KMU die Möglichkeit planbar und effizient zu wachsen. Du definierst wie wir darüber sprechen, und prägst damit nicht nur unsere Marke, sondern einen ganzen Markt.

  • Direkt mit dem Gründerteam: Du arbeitest täglich mit uns drei Gründern zusammen, ohne Hierarchie dazwischen. Du sitzt mit am Tisch, wenn wir über Positionierung, Zielgruppen und Kampagnen entscheiden.

  • Maßgeblicher Einfluss von Tag eins: Du bist die erste Person im Marketing. Was du aufbaust, wird zum Fundament, auf dem unser künftiges Marketingteam aufsetzt.

  • Spannende Geschichten: Du sprichst mit Unternehmern aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und erzählst, wie sie mit selqo neue Kunden gewinnen.

Dein Profil

Erfahrung

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft oder Medien.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau: klar, verständlich und ohne Floskeln.

  • Du hast schon eigene Projekte umgesetzt, zum Beispiel einen Social-Media-Kanal, einen Blog oder ein kleines Business.

Mindset

  • Du packst Dinge an, ohne auf Anweisungen zu warten.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich und bist neugierig auf neue Formate.

  • Du interessierst dich für B2B, Vertrieb und den Mittelstand.

  • Du hast Lust, mit einem jungen Start-up zu wachsen und die Marke von Anfang an mitzuprägen.

Was wir bieten

  • Die Chance, ein Startup, das einen neue Kategorie prägt, von Anfang an maßgeblich mitzugestalten

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründerteam und Einblick in alle Bereiche, von Produkt über Vertrieb bis Finanzierung

  • Attraktive Vergütung von 20 € pro Stunde bei 16–20 Stunden pro Woche

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen

  • Arbeitsplatz in Paderborn

  • Die Aussicht, nach dem Studium mit uns weiterzuwachsen und das Marketing mit aufzubauen

Bewerbung

Schick uns einfach einen kurzen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Sätze zu deinen bisherigen Projekten mit Marketingbezug.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen jeden Hintergrunds, Geschlechts, Alters und jeder Herkunft.

jobs.title: Consultant SAP S/4HANA Transformation
jobs.description:
Für viele Unternehmen ist S/4HANA ein Pflicht-Upgrade. Bei UNITY ist es deine Mission, daraus eine echte unternehmerische Entscheidung für unsere Kunden zu machen: Wohin soll sich die Prozess- und Systemlandschaft bewegen? Was kostet welcher Weg und wer setzt ihn um? Und wie bleibt das Programm steuerbar? Du sitzt auf der Seite des Kunden. Du gestaltest End-to-End-Prozesse, Zielarchitektur und Programmsteuerung. Die technische Implementierung übernimmt unser Partnernetzwerk.

Unser Anspruch als Business Integrator: Wir schützen das, was unsere Kunden vom Wettbewerb unterscheidet (wir nennen das „Prozess-DNA“) und helfen ihnen zu verstehen, was sich nicht unterscheiden sollte.

Das erwartet dich

  • Transformationspfad entwickeln: Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und Team an Vorprojekten zur Auswahl von ERP-Systemen samt Definition von Zielbild, Leitplanken, Zielarchitektur, Deploymentvariante (RISE vs. GROW, Cloud vs. On-Premise) und Transformationspfad (Greenfield, Brownfield, Lift-&-Shift) inklusive Business Case.

  • Zielarchitektur mitgestalten: Du arbeitest an Clean-Core-Konzepten, an SAP Business AI Platform (BAIP) – auf Basis von SAP BTP als Entkopplungsplattform und an Datenstrategien, etwa für Datasphere oder SAP Analytics Cloud.

  • Programme transparent begleiten: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung einer tragfähigen Roadmap und sorgst im PMO mit Tools wie SAP Signavio, LeanIX und SAP Cloud ALM für Klarheit über Fortschritt, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.

  • Den richtigen Partner an Bord holen: Du gestaltest Transformationsausschreibungen – im Mittelstand und Konzern ebenso wie vergaberechtskonform bei öffentlichen Auftraggebern und Kliniken.

  • KI dort einsetzen, wo sie wirkt: Du identifizierst Use Cases for SAP Business AI und Joule, etwa in der Custom-Code-Analyse, bei der Datenqualität oder mit unseren KI-Agents in Einkauf, Supply Chain und Order-to-Cash.

  • Branchenwissen aufbauen: Du arbeitest in Industrie und Handel, im Krankenhaus (IS-H-Ablösung, KIS-Szenarien) oder in der Energiewirtschaft (IS-U).

Künstliche Intelligenz @UNITY

Bei UNITY arbeitest du mit KI, die du selbst mitgestalten kannst: die eigenentwickelte UNITY X-Plattform gibt dir Zugriff auf verschiedene Claude-, ChatGPT & Gemini Modelle. Copilot und Claude-Modelle sind direkt in Teams und den Microsoft-Anwendungen verfügbar. In Copilot Studio kannst du außerdem eigene Agenten bauen, wenn du willst. UNITY Coding Communities, Hackathons, AI Labs und das AI Trainings Camp geben dir Raum, eigene Lösungen für intern und für Kunden zu bauen.

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves Junior

  • Erste Praxiserfahrung entweder in einer Management- oder IT-Beratung oder auf Kundenseite in der Industrie

  • Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse in mindestens einem Bereich, zum Beispiel Finance, Logistik, Einkauf, Produktion oder Vertrieb, und Freude daran, diese zu analysieren und zu optimieren

  • Grundkenntnisse der SAP-Vorgehensmodelle, etwa SAP Activate, und der Migrationsszenarien

  • Die Fähigkeit, KI wirksam und sicher anzuwenden.

  • Prägnante Kommunikation und Präsentation auf Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (mindestens B2)

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Produktionstechnik oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss mit technischem oder betriebswirtschaftlichem Schwerpunkt

Idealerweise

  • Erste Erfahrungen aus SAP-S/4HANA-Projekten

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit SAP BTP, Signavio oder LeanIX

  • Branchenerfahrung in Industrie, Healthcare oder Energie

  • (Senior Level): Entwicklung Architektur-Roadmaps rund um Clean Core und BTP.

  • (Senior Level): Übernahme von Teilprojektleitungen oder Streamleadfunktion.

Senior Level: Das bringst du zusätzlich mit

  • Du hast bereits mindestens eine S/4HANA-Transformation über mehrere Phasen begleitet.

  • Du bist an der Steuerung von Implementierungspartnern beteiligt gewesen und hast Scope-Entscheidungen mit dem Management deiner Kunden mitgetroffen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Sammlung und Darstellung von Use Cases und/oder Change-Requests im Kontext von SAP S/4HANA Transformations-Programmen.

  • Juniors coachst du im Projekt, und du bringst eigene Ideen in unser SAP-Leistungsangebot ein.

Ehrlich gesagt: Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du vor allem selbst customizen oder in ABAP entwickeln willst. Die Implementierung liegt bei unseren Partnern, deine Stärke liegt im Steuern, Gestalten und Entscheiden. Sie passt auch nicht, wenn du lieber ein Modul tief betreust, als den Blick über Prozesse, Daten und Organisation hinweg zu weiten. Wenn dich dagegen die Frage reizt, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt messbarer Business-Nutzen wird, dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Deine Chancen und Möglichkeiten

  • Projekte mit Substanz: Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Strategie bis zum Go-Live, in Industrie, Healthcare und Energie, und siehst, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt Business-Nutzen wird.

  • Fachlicher Austausch auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest mit den Köpfen hinter unserem SAP-Angebot, darunter unsere Heads of SAP Architecture & Innovation und SAP Transformation Excellence.

  • Partnernetzwerk statt Einzelkämpfertum: Du steuerst gemeinsam mit Implementierungspartnern, statt alles selbst zu bauen, und lernst dabei die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette einer Transformation kennen.

  • SAP-Innovation aus erster Hand: Mit unserem zentralen KI-Team, AI Labs und Hackathons entwickelst du Business-AI-Use-Cases für den SAP-Kontext mit.

  • Entwicklung vom Junior zum Senior: Deine SAP-Laufbahn ist bei uns kein Zufall, sondern ein Pfad bis zur Projektleitung und Architekturverantwortung. UNITY unterstützt diese Entwicklung mit konkreten Zertifizierungen, die zu deinem Entwicklungsziel passen, sowie einem breiten Portfolio an Fach- und Persönlichkeitsentwicklungsschulungen.

  • KI, die wir selbst bauen: Zentrales KI-Team, AI Labs, Hackathons und unsere eigene UNITY X-Plattform – du entwickelst Business-AI-Use-Cases mit, statt sie nur zu präsentieren.

  • Wohnort-Freiheit: Du arbeitest an dem deutschen UNITY-Standort, der zu dir passt, zur Auswahl stehen neun.

  • Verwirkliche mit uns deine Big Five for Life in einer Kultur, die von Vertrauen, Authentizität und Zusammenhalt geprägt ist.

  • Und obendrauf: Unternehmerischer Freiraum für eigene Ideen, flexible Arbeitsmodelle (u. a. Homeoffice), Sabbaticals, persönliches Coaching, Mentoring und UNITYacademy, ein individuelles Mobilitätskonzept, JobRad, Urban Sports Club und mehr.

*UNITY lebt Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit. Bei uns ist jeder unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Handicap, Religion und Alter willkommen.

Deine ersten Monate

Zu Beginn: Du lernst unsere Produkte, Tarife und typischen Kundenanliegen kennen. Du arbeitest dich in unsere Systeme ein und übernimmst schrittweise eigene Anfragen.

Nach der Einarbeitung: Du bearbeitest die üblichen Anliegen selbstständig, übernimmst telefonische Kontakte und klärst komplexere Fälle mit den zuständigen Fachleuten.

Mit dem weiteren Ausbau: Telefonische Beratung, Kundenbindung und ausgehende Gespräche werden zu einem größeren Teil deiner Arbeit.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Erfahrung im Customer Support, Kundenservice oder in der Kundenberatung, idealerweise bei einem digitalen Produkt oder Abo-Anbieter.

  • Du formulierst klare, freundliche Antworten und kannst auch kompliziertere Abläufe verständlich erklären.

  • Du telefonierst gern, hörst aufmerksam zu und bleibst auch bei unzufriedenen Kund:innen ruhig und verbindlich.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, setzt Prioritäten und behältst offene Anliegen im Blick.

  • Du findest dich sicher in digitalen Anwendungen zurecht und lernst neue Systeme und Produkte zügig kennen.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch.

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Samstagseinsätzen nach abgestimmtem Dienstplan.

Ein Plus sind Erfahrungen mit Ticketsystemen, Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie, Kundenbindung oder Tarifberatung. Auch Kenntnisse rund um Websites, Online-Shops und Datenschutz helfen dir beim Einstieg.

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt, deine Verlässlichkeit und die Bereitschaft, dich in unsere Produkte einzuarbeiten.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Fachliche Unterstützung: Bei technischen und rechtlich relevanten Fragen stehen dir IT und Partnerkanzlei zur Seite.

  • Ein Team im Aufbau: Du steigst in einen Bereich ein, dessen Abläufe und Zusammenarbeit wir gerade weiterentwickeln. Deine Erfahrungen aus dem Kundenkontakt fließen dabei ein.

  • Mehr als schriftlicher Support: Mit dem Ausbau der Telefonie kommen deine Fähigkeiten in Beratung und Kundenbindung zum Tragen.

  • Direkter Austausch: Du arbeitest eng mit der Support-Teamleitung und deinen Kolleg:innen zusammen und gibst Kundenfeedback an die zuständigen Teams weiter.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit.

  • Arbeitsort Berlin mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit an telefoniefreien Tagen.

  • Einsatz im Rahmen unserer Serviceabdeckung von Montag bis Samstag.

  • Samstagseinsätze werden mit der Support-Teamleitung abgestimmt.

  • Telefoniedienste finden vor Ort statt.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns sprechen: ein kurzes Kennenlernen, ein Fachgespräch und anschließend ein Einblick ins Team mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus unserem Support-Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in deiner Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welche Kundenanfragen bearbeitest du heute oder hast du zuletzt bearbeitet, schriftlich und telefonisch?

  2. Beschreibe ein schwieriges Kundenanliegen: Wie bist du vorgegangen und wie hast du es gelöst?

jobs.title: AI DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (32–40 Std./Woche) | ab sofort | deutschlandweit, hybrid oder remote

Deine RAG-Pipeline läuft im Notebook, aber niemand hat sie in Produktion gebracht? Genau das lösen wir. Das UNITY AI Booster Team bringt LLM- und Agentic-AI-Systeme unserer Kunden zuverlässig, sicher und wirtschaftlich live.

Das UNITY AI Booster Team

Das UNITY AI Booster Team ist UNITYs Entwicklereinheit für die Entwicklung und Implementierung von KI-Lösungen in den Geschäftsprozessen unserer Kunden. Wir entwickeln Lösungen mit hoher Technologiebandbreite, von Machine Learning Use Cases, LLM Use Cases oder eigenen Agentenplattformen. Anders als unsere Consultants sind wir näher am Code: Wir arbeiten im Projekt mit den Consultants und unserem Procurement X Team zusammen, bauen und betreiben aber die technische Plattform dahinter.

Das erwartet dich

Infrastruktur für produktive KI-Anwendungen bauen und betreiben – von der Dev-Umgebung über CI/CD bis zum stabilen Betrieb beim Kunden und außerdem:

  • LLM- und Agentic-AI-Systeme in Betrieb bringen: Inferenz- und Model-Serving-Endpunkte, Vektordatenbanken, RAG-Pipelines, MCP-Server – skalierbar, sicher, kostenbewusst.
  • Observability und Qualität verantworten: Latenzen, Token- und Infrastrukturkosten, Agenten-Tracing, automatisierte Eval- und Regressionstests.
  • Konsequent automatisieren statt Handarbeit: Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, containerisierte, reproduzierbare Deployments.
  • Sicherheit und Compliance sicherstellen: Secrets- und Zugriffsmanagement, Guardrails, Nachvollziehbarkeit nach EU AI Act.
  • Kunden bei Architektur- und Betriebsentscheidungen beraten – als technischer Sparringspartner*, nicht als Kundenmanager*.

Was du hier lernst

  • MLOps-/LLMOps-Patterns im echten Kundenbetrieb statt im Lehrbuch.
  • Wie man KI-Systeme so baut, dass sie den EU AI Act überstehen, statt ihn nachträglich zu reparieren.
  • Den Sprung vom PoC zur produktiven, kosten- und latenzbewussten Plattform.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von Software.
  • Senior-Rolle: mehrjährige Praxis im Design und Betrieb produktiver Systeme
  • Solide DevOps-Basis: Container/Kubernetes, CI/CD, agiles Entwicklungsumfeld.
  • Cloud-Erfahrung (AWS, Azure oder GCP), Deployment als Container, API oder Serverless.
  • Praxis mit Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform, Ansible, Helm oder GitOps).
  • Python plus mindestens eine weitere Sprache (Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# oder Shell).
  • Grundverständnis von LLM-Systemen: RAG-Architekturen, Prompting, Agenten-Frameworks (z. B. LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI).
  • Deutsch ab C1, Englisch ab B2 – sicher im Kundenkontakt, auch mal einen Workshop leiten.
  • Studienabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, KI oder vergleichbar – oder gleichwertige Praxis als Quereinsteiger* z.B. mit einer abgeschlossenen Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker * Systemintegration.

Idealterweise bringst du zusätzlich mit:

  • MLOps-/LLMOps-Praxis inkl. Evaluation von LLM-Pipelines.
  • AI-Observability-Tools (Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, OpenTelemetry-basiert).
  • Vektordatenbanken (Elasticsearch, pgvector, Qdrant o. ä.) und MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  • Model Serving/GPU-Betrieb (vLLM, Ray, KServe, Triton), FinOps für KI-Workloads.
  • Eigene Open-Source-Projekte oder Community-Beiträge.
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichem Bereitschaftsdienst (nur tagsüber, vergütet).

Für wen das hier nichts ist:

  • Wer beim PoC aufhört und Produktionsbetrieb für das Problem von jemand anderem hält.
  • Wer Kundenkontakt komplett vermeiden will – ihr sprecht mit IT-Verantwortlichen auf Augenhöhe, das gehört dazu.
  • Wer lieber Tools evaluiert, als Systeme zu verantworten, die nachts nicht ausfallen dürfen.

Warum das AI Booster Team & Über uns

  • Du bist näher am Code als in jeder Beratungsrolle. Wir sitzen im Projekt, aber unser Ergebnis ist laufende Software, keine Präsentation.
  • Du siehst deine Systeme im Einsatz. Wir bauen nicht auf Zuruf für einen anonymen Backlog, sondern für Kunden, deren Prozesse wir kennen – und begleiten die Lösung in den Betrieb.
  • Technologiebandbreite statt Monokultur: Machine Learning, LLM-Anwendungen und eigene Agentenplattformen – je nach Problem, nicht je nach Hausstandard.
  • Remote ist bei uns möglich, nicht nur geduldet: deutschlandweit, hybrid oder vollständig remote.
  • Weitere Benefits: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle · Sabbaticals · persönliches Coaching, Mentoring & UNITYacademy · JobRad, UrbanSports u. v. m. · Verwirklichung eigener Ideen und unternehmerischer Freiraum · Verwirkliche mit uns deine Big Five for Life**

Über uns

UNITY ist die Managementberatung für Innovation und digitale Transformation. Dabei setzen wir insbesondere auf Künstliche Intelligenz als Schlüsseltechnologie für Effizienz und Wachstum. Mit 380 Mitarbeitern sind wir weltweit an 15 Standorten vertreten und führen rund um den Globus Kundenprojekte durch.

Unsere Standorte, an denen du deutschlandweit arbeiten kannst: Berlin, Braunschweig, Frankfurt a. M., Hamburg, Köln, München, Nürnberg, Paderborn/Büren oder Stuttgart.

jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

The ground that judgment stands on:

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them.

  • Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability.

And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term).

What great looks like

People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder.

What we’re uncompromising about

How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound.

That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it.

Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.

jobs.title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
jobs.description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes:

  • Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

  • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals.

The problems waiting for you

  • Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff.

  • Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not.

  • Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries.

  • Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy.

  • Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible.

  • More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference).

  • Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation.

  • Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino.

Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, real-world data.

Who you are

You are a physicist and an engineer at once. You judge a method by whether it holds up in production at real scale, and you do not stop until it does. No blind spots: you relentlessly hunt down even the defect that looks insignificant, because it never is.

  • A strong background in physics-based simulation, preferably related to robotics: RBD, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC, XPBD, VBD, ABD, plus constrained optimization and numerical integration of stiff systems.

  • A track record of shipping simulation code that others rely on, in an engine, in industry, or in a research codebase used beyond its authors.

  • Solid HPC programming (CPU and/or GPU), and an instinct for what makes a numerical method fast in practice, beyond complexity classes.

  • Rigor in validation: analytical closed forms, cross-engine consistency, real-world data.

Bonus points: publications in simulation, graphics, or robotics venues (SIGGRAPH, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS). Contributions to an open-source physics engine.

jobs.description:

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI’s strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

Simulation is still a hard sell in robotics. Outside a few success stories, like reinforcement learning for locomotion, most teams skip it, and friction is a big part of why: painful to use, painful to debug. We live that pain ourselves: debugging a failing experiment during policy evaluation takes 30 minutes, and there is no way to automatically generate a standalone reproduction script. That blocks adoption, even internally.

Your job is to kill that friction. You build the software engineering backbone of Genesis-World: everything that makes a large, fast-moving simulation codebase reliable, maintainable, frictionless. And it all ships in the open. Every hour of pain you remove, you remove for every roboticist who comes after you.

You join as core maintainer of Genesis-World, with shared stewardship of the whole platform from day one. Our physics team develops the algorithms, but just as importantly, you work to make everything around them excellent: infrastructure, tooling, APIs, architecture.

The problems waiting for you

  • Make testing of a JIT-compiled engine scalable. Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis-World and the compiler teams.

  • Make any bug reproducible. Dump and reload simulations bit-exactly, across machines, across backends, even when a single timestep of a batched simulation can already max out VRAM. Turn any failing run into a standalone reproduction script, automatically.

  • Make autodiff first-class. Genesis-World is differentiable today, but partially: memory-hungry, slower than it could be, and hard to maintain due to manual operation recording. The project spans the engine and the compiler: you drive the requirements on Quadrants and iterate in a tight loop with the compiler team until the integration is solid.

  • Edit scenes at frozen time. See the scene, move entities and robots around, iterate on layout, all without building the scene or compiling the engine. Authoring today means a full build cycle. Make it instant.

  • Make the simulator extensible. First-class plugins for physics solvers and interactive viewer backends, including Nyx. Sensors already work this way. Generalize it, and Genesis-World becomes a platform others build on.

  • Give robots real actuation. Motors and MIMO transmissions, cleanly abstracted at the interface between users and the physics engine.

  • Make time a local variable. Today the clock and the timestep are global to the engine, which forbids whole classes of speedups: environments cannot step independently, the timestep cannot adapt to the state, and individual solvers cannot advance at their own rate. Free the clock down to the sub-scene level and let the simulation fly.

  • Make scenes come alive. Events triggered by physics: press the button and the microwave door pops open, squeeze the trigger and the drill spins.

  • Keep the core sharp. Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay.

Other JIT compilers such as Triton, JAX, or Numba. 3D tooling and interactive editors (Maya, Blender, Houdini). Serialization formats (USD, glTF, MJCF/URDF). C++, CUDA, or Metal. We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🏅 The Role:

We're hiring a Staff Machine Learning Engineer (L4) for Pricing in Rosso.

Rosso is tem's core IP. It forecasts prices and volumes, holds a live view of our portfolio, and sets the fees on every quote. You'll join the pricing ML team and own key components of our dynamic pricing system. The direction is set. Within your components, choosing the bets and proving whether they worked is yours. This is a hands-on role. Most of your week will be writing and shipping production code, and you'll stay accountable for what that code does once it's live.

You will:

  • Own key components of our dynamic pricing system end to end, from design through to running them in production.

  • Choose the bets within those components most likely to reduce sales adjustment, and show whether they worked.

  • Make your components observable, guarded and replayable, so a wrong price is caught before a customer sees it.

  • Unblock your own delivery across engineering, platform and commercial teams.

You will report into the ML Leader for Rosso.

🚀 Responsibilities:

  • Own key components of dynamic pricing

    • Take ownership of one or more core components, such as the models that learn from won and lost deals, the experimentation and measurement layer, or the live guardrails that keep price changes safe.

    • Within your components, choose between competing bets based on which is most likely to move the metric, and stop the ones that don't.

    • Design experiments and holdouts that work with low-volume, high-value deals, where a textbook A/B test often isn't possible.

    Run it live, safely

    • Build the monitoring, alerting, guardrails and staged release your components need. That includes detecting drift, catching runaway feedback loops and holding unexpected price moves for review.

    • Make any pricing decision your components produce reproducible after the fact, for debugging and for regulators.

    • Work with the Price Quoting squad and ML Platform so models are built for production from the start, not handed over at the end.

    Close the loop with the business

    • Find out why sales teams adjust prices, and turn those reasons into model inputs or new bets.

    • Explain model behaviour and trade-offs to engineers, product and commercial colleagues clearly enough that they can act on it.

    • Redesign the team's recurring pricing workflows with AI built in, such as feedback triage, daily price review and experiment write-ups. Decide which steps stay human.🎯

🎯 Requirements:

Must-haves:

  • You build. Most of your current role is writing and shipping production code, and you want to keep it that way. This is not a people leadership role or an architecture role where others implement.

  • You have owned a live ML system that made automated decisions with money attached, for example in algorithmic trading, dynamic pricing, marketplaces, ad bidding, credit or betting. You have dealt with its failures in production, such as feedback loops, silent drift, bad outputs reaching customers and rollbacks, and changed how you build because of them.

  • Strong probabilistic modelling and decision-making under uncertainty, such as pricing, conversion or elasticity modelling, and experimentation. You formulate the problem from first principles and pick the simplest approach that works.

  • You've run ML as production services on modern cloud infrastructure: containerised models behind APIs, event-driven microservices, infrastructure as code and CI/CD on AWS or similar. Your model changes go through the same pipeline, tests and rollback as any other code, so shipping one on a Thursday afternoon is routine.

  • Production-grade Python, and a habit of designing for observability, testing and replay. You work as a peer with software engineers.

  • A track record of moving a commercial metric, working alongside product managers and commercial stakeholders to get there.

  • You use AI tooling as a day-to-day multiplier on your own work, and you know where it fails.

Energy experience is not required. We will teach you the market. What we can't teach quickly is the judgement that comes from running a live pricing or trading system.

Bonus points:

  • Experience in energy, commodities or other markets where prices, forecasts and risk interact.

  • Contextual bandits, causal inference or Bayesian methods used in production.

  • Stochastic optimisation or operations research.

  • A PhD in a field such as maths, physics, computer science or operations research.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Salary: Competitive. We are looking to pay £115,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  • Stock Options: everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays. Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.

  • Remote working: we're fully remote, distributed across Europe

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:
