jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description:
About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

Location and availability

Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France.

We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position.

We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.

jobs.title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
jobs.description:
About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse.

We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

Marketing Automation & Workflow Optimisation

jobs.title: Responsable HSE Data Center (H/F) – Multi-sites
jobs.description:
Responsable HSE (H/F) – Multi-sites France

L’entreprise
Notre client est un acteur international de référence dans les infrastructures numériques et l’hébergement de données. Il exploite plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, au cœur de l’économie digitale. Dans le cadre de son développement, il recrute sa/son Responsable HSE.

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) à la Direction, vous définissez, déployez et animez la politique Hygiène, Santé, Sécurité et Environnement sur l’ensemble des sites français. Vous êtes le garant de la conformité réglementaire, de la maîtrise des risques et de l’amélioration continue de la performance HSE. Vous travaillez aux côtés des équipes opérationnelles, des projets et des prestataires pour faire vivre une culture sécurité exigeante et partagée.

Vos responsabilités

Stratégie et pilotage HSE

  • Élaborer et faire évoluer la politique HSE, en cohérence avec la stratégie, la réglementation et les référentiels ISO

  • Fixer les objectifs et priorités HSE à court, moyen et long terme, puis les décliner en standards, procédures et plans d’actions

  • Conseiller la Direction et les managers sur toute décision ayant un impact HSE

  • Définir les indicateurs, analyser les résultats et assurer le reporting auprès des instances de gouvernance

Culture sécurité et système de management

  • Promouvoir une culture de prévention fondée sur l’exemplarité et la remontée des situations dangereuses

  • Rédiger et harmoniser les procédures, consignes et supports HSE

  • Piloter le programme d’audits internes et le traitement des non-conformités

  • Définir les besoins de formation avec les managers et les RH, et animer accueils sécurité, causeries et campagnes de prévention

Conformité réglementaire

  • Assurer la veille réglementaire (santé-sécurité au travail, environnement)

  • Évaluer la conformité des sites et piloter les plans de mise en conformité (Code du travail, ICPE, ISO, standards internes)

  • Préparer les inspections et audits, et être l’interlocuteur des organismes de contrôle et des autorités

Prévention des risques

  • Évaluer les risques professionnels et contribuer à la mise à jour du DUERP

  • Superviser plans de prévention, protocoles de sécurité, permis de travail et analyses de risques

  • Garantir la maîtrise des activités à risque : travaux électriques, en hauteur, en espaces confinés, par point chaud, manutentions, produits chimiques

Gestion des événements HSE

  • Organiser la déclaration et l’analyse des accidents, presqu’accidents et situations dangereuses

  • Piloter les analyses de causes profondes et suivre l’efficacité des actions correctives

  • Contribuer aux plans d’urgence, à la gestion de crise et aux exercices de sécurité

Environnement

  • Identifier et évaluer les aspects et impacts environnementaux

  • Piloter la gestion des déchets, des produits chimiques, de l’eau et de l’énergie, ainsi que la prévention des pollutions

  • Définir les objectifs de réduction de l’empreinte environnementale avec les équipes techniques et RSE

Maîtrise HSE des prestataires

  • Définir les exigences HSE applicables aux sous-traitants et fournisseurs

  • Vérifier habilitations et documents avant intervention, réaliser inspections terrain et audits

  • Suivre la clôture des écarts et contribuer à l’évaluation de la performance HSE des fournisseurs

Votre profil

  • Formation Bac+5 en HSE, QHSE, prévention des risques ou environnement

  • Expérience confirmée (5 ans minimum) sur un poste similaire, idéalement en environnement multi-sites, industriel ou technique

  • Solide maîtrise de la réglementation HSE, de l’ICPE et des normes ISO 45001 / ISO 14001

  • Expérience de la gestion des entreprises extérieures et des travaux à risque

  • Leadership, pédagogie et sens du terrain : vous savez convaincre aussi bien la Direction que les équipes opérationnelles

  • Anglais professionnel apprécié dans un contexte international

Conditions - Avantages :

Bonus /an : 2 mois de salaire si atteint

Indemnité multi sites : 1 500 euros annuel

Participation (1,5 mois de salaire)

jobs.title: Vestigingsmanager Onderwijs
jobs.description:
Wil jij de verantwoordelijkheid over jouw eigen vestiging, leidinggeven aan een team én dagelijks impact maken op de ontwikkeling van jongeren? Bij Lyceo combineer je ondernemerschap, management en onderwijs in één rol. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, volop vrijheid en de kans om zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de groei van leerlingen én jouw vestiging.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Vestigingsmanager

Als Vestigingsmanager ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw Lyceo-vestiging. Dankzij jouw inzet krijgen leerlingen de begeleiding die hen helpt effectiever te leren, meer zelfvertrouwen te ontwikkelen en betere resultaten te behalen. Je runt jouw eigen vestiging als een ondernemer binnen de organisatie. Daarbij stuur je een team van studentbegeleiders aan, onderhoud je contact met ouders en scholen en zorg je ervoor dat de vestiging kwalitatief én organisatorisch optimaal presteert. Je bent dagelijks zichtbaar aanwezig, signaleert kansen in de regio en bouwt aan duurzame samenwerkingen met scholen en ouders. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Juist die combinatie van management en persoonlijke begeleiding maakt deze rol zo afwisselend en betekenisvol.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • leidinggeven aan, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team studentbegeleiders;

  • voeren van intake-, evaluatie- en adviesgesprekken met leerlingen en ouders;

  • organiseren van roosters, administratie en plannen van aanpak;

  • opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met scholen en andere stakeholders in de regio;

  • actief onderdeel zijn van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en leerlingen ondersteunen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding;

  • realiseren van groei, kwaliteit en resultaat binnen jouw vestiging.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

• hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren;

• ondernemende instelling en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

• commercieel inzicht en oog voor groei en resultaat;

• sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden;

• we zoeken kandidaten op goede reisafstand van jouw vestiging. We hebben momenteel kansen in de volgende plaatsen: Hengelo, Utrecht, Laren en Delft.

Jouw werkgebied

Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Bussum, Laren en Delft.

Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging.

Benefits

Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

• volledig door Lyceo betaalde pensioenbijdrage van 6%;

• variabele beloningsmogelijkheden gekoppeld aan resultaten en groei;

• een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week, net wat past bij jouw situatie, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

• vrij tijdens de schoolvakanties*;

• laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

• volledige ov-vergoeding of reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer;

• toegang tot de Lyceo Academie met diverse trainingen en opleidingen;

• persoonlijke begeleiding door een clustermanager en een eigen buddy;

• aantrekkelijke kortingen via Benefits At Work;

• regelmatige borrels, teamuitjes en een jaarlijks feest;

• betekenisvol werk, waarbij resultaat en impact hand in hand gaan.

*Naast de meivakantie en de laatste week van de zomervakantie ben je tijdens alle schoolvakanties vrij. Hiervoor wordt maandelijks 5,77% ingehouden ter compensatie van deze bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen, naast de 25 wettelijke vakantiedagen. Je bouwt vakantiegeld en pensioen op over je volledige bruto maandsalaris.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen.

Als marktleider binnen dit domein is Lyceo volop in beweging. De organisatie groeit hard en heeft duidelijke ambities voor de toekomst. Je komt terecht in een betrokken en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat, maar waar ook ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën.

De impact is groot: scholen beoordelen Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger. We zoeken continu naar de beste samenwerking tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs en doen er alles aan om ieder kind tot z’n recht te laten komen.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

About the role


We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control.


Your main mission will be to:

  • Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment variables or app configuration, Kubernetes or ArgoCD resources) into ready-to-review GitHub Pull Requests:

    1. Understand. The agent parses the request and picks the matching runbook.

    2. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories.

    3. Validate. It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans.

    4. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval.

  • Design the guardrails that make this safe: least-privilege access, approval steps, and predictable, repeatable runs. The AI never changes production on its own, and engineers stay in control of every change,

  • Deliver a working proof of concept on real internal requests, built so it can grow into a production-ready tool.

The AI never changes production on its own. Engineers stay in control, and every change is reviewed, tested and traceable.


Our infrastructure stack

  • Cloud: AWS, multi-region

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

  • Containers & GitOps: Kubernetes on EKS, Helm, ArgoCD

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & Compliance: vulnerability and misconfiguration scanning, least-privilege IAM, and a HITRUST/SOC2-driven change process

  • Backend: Elixir/Phoenix

About the profile


Sonio is a mission-driven company so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

  • Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,

  • Good knowledge of AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Git and CI/CD workflows,

  • Solid scripting skills (Python or similar) and a security-minded approach to infrastructure changes,

  • Strong interest in AI agents and LLMs applied to real engineering problems,

  • Experience with ArgoCD, Helm or Datadog is a plus,

  • You speak English and ideally French.

We move fast and aspire to be transparent over the process - our objective is that the process from the first chat to an offer is no longer than a month. We also aspire to give an answer to every application in a week - if you have not heard from us, please follow up at -----

About Us

We are an early-stage startup that builds the future of how individuals and healthcare providers will interact with health related data. One of our products is a consumer mobile application that integrates with our health partners and is based on our intelligent data platform. To drive its further development, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager.

The Role

You will be responsible for shaping the product vision and roadmap with the team, creating an experience that patients and physicians find immediately valuable. Partnering closely with the engineering and business teams, you will translate complex AI functionality into a trusted, globally scalable product that grows through our partners and its own value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop an inspiring product vision that aligns with the broader startup strategy and creates meaningful value for patients and healthcare professionals and partners

  • Define a roadmap focused on immediate "time-to-value" and features that amaze its users.

  • Identify and deeply understand the needs, pain points, and user journeys of patients and healthcare professionals to design compelling and engaging user interface mocks.

  • Engineer partner- and product-led growth mechanics for instant onboarding and shareable moments.

  • Balance the fast iteration of a consumer app with the safety and quality required for medical software, consider privacy by design.

  • Lead cross-functionally, measuring success by user delight, growth and retention.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in Product Management, ideally in high-growth startups.

  • AI-native expertise: you know how to embed AI into the product and your own workflow.

  • Experience with design tools and/or rapid prototype software, e.g., Figma, Lovable, Claude Code, to effectively convey ideas and explore options.

  • Skills to prepare and deliver technical presentations to senior leadership and/or investors in an inspiring way.

  • A self-starter mindset: you take ownership, structure ambiguous problems yourself and deliver, reliably and on time.

Preferred Qualifications

Why Join Us

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Zürich. We work in a hybrid setup, but strongly believe in the power and magic to collaborate most working days together in the office.

You will join a small team in a fast moving environment. You will have meaningful ownership without being expected to manage a team initially.

jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.description:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges.

Challenges You’ll Work On

  • Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work.

  • Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches.

  • Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt.

  • Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs).

  • Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle.

  • Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems.


About You

  • You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction.

  • You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning.

  • You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications.

  • You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data.

  • You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with frontier tabular ML methods.

  • Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available.

Compensation

Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits).

 

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

For U.S. candidates, current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

Working at Poesis

As an early team member, you’ll help shape not just the product, but how the company operates. Your decisions will have lasting impact across the business. You’ll build from first principles, with no legacy systems, or entrenched processes slowing you down. Our team is made up of people from elite companies and universities who are low ego, collaborative, and excited to build together.

En un coup d’œil

  • Contrat : CDI, à pourvoir dès que possible

  • Périmètre : Paris exclusivement, sans tournées régionales

  • Expérience : 3-5 ans minimum en vente full cycle SaaS B2B

 
 

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d’expertise-comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio accélère pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l’accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour accompagner cette accélération, nous cherchons un·e Account Executive Cabinets sur le périmètre Paris exclusivement, sans tournées régionales : un profil commercial qui aime prospecter, comprendre des enjeux métier exigeants et transformer une relation de confiance en signature.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu développes ton portefeuille de cabinets en full cycle, de la prospection au closing. Tu es responsable de ton pipeline et de tes opportunités, avec l’appui des équipes Product, Tech, Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA).

 

🧭 Tes missions

Prospecter et créer tes opportunités

  • Prendre en charge l’inbound de ton périmètre : qualifier les demandes, mener les découvertes, traiter les sollicitations avec réactivité et assurer des relances structurées

  • Identifier les cabinets à potentiel et construire une prospection ciblée via les canaux adaptés : online, événementiel, mises en relation et rencontres terrain

  • Combiner appels, emails, mises en relation et rendez-vous pour ouvrir de nouvelles conversations

Qualifier, démontrer et conclure

  • Comprendre l’organisation du cabinet, ses usages, ses irritants et ses enjeux de changement de logiciel de paie

  • Qualifier les besoins, les interlocuteurs, le processus de décision et le calendrier du projet

  • Préparer et mener des démonstrations adaptées, en mobilisant les expertises internes lorsque nécessaire

  • Piloter chaque étape du cycle : suivi des échanges, traitement des objections, proposition commerciale, négociation et closing

  • Maintenir un pipeline fiable, avec des prochaines étapes claires et des prévisions commerciales argumentées

  • Préparer une transmission fluide aux équipes Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA) pour que les engagements pris pendant la vente soient compris et partagés

Développer une présence terrain sur ton périmètre

Organiser des rendez-vous dans les cabinets parisiens, rencontrer les décideurs et développer un réseau local de cabinets et de prescripteurs. Représenter Alassio lors de salons et d’événements du secteur comptable et social à Paris, puis assurer le suivi commercial des contacts. Articuler rendez-vous en présentiel et échanges à distance : les déplacements sont locaux, dans Paris uniquement.

Contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

  • Participer aux points d’équipe, aux revues de pipeline et aux échanges de pratiques

  • Partager les objections, les signaux marché et les apprentissages utiles au collectif dans une organisation lean et product-led

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des messages, des supports et des méthodes commerciales, sans perdre de vue tes objectifs principaux

 

🛠️ Une collaboration rapprochée avec la Tech et le Product

Chez Alassio, les Sales ne travaillent pas à distance du produit. Tu échanges régulièrement avec les équipes Tech et Product pour comprendre ce que nous construisons, préparer les démonstrations, éclaircir les cas d’usage et faire remonter les besoins du terrain avec précision.

Tu sais contextualiser les contraintes d’un cabinet, distinguer un besoin d’une demande de fonctionnalité et aligner ton discours commercial sur les capacités réelles du produit, sans promettre ce qui n’est pas validé.

 

🤖 Notre OS interne au quotidien

CRM, documentation partagée, IA et automatisations sont des leviers pour mieux prospecter, préparer tes rendez-vous et assurer ton suivi. Tu prends rapidement en main de nouveaux outils, documentes tes échanges, maintiens une information fiable et partages les pratiques qui rendent l’équipe plus efficace.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la vente full cycle en SaaS B2B, sur des cycles impliquant plusieurs interlocuteurs et du présentiel

  • Une autonomie de lead generation : tu sais créer tes opportunités et mener une prospection régulière, sans attendre qu’on t’alimente en leads

  • Une capacité à conduire une découverte approfondie, démontrer la valeur, assurer le suivi commercial et négocier jusqu’à la signature

  • Une connaissance de l’écosystème comptable ou de la paie est un plus ; l’anglais professionnel est apprécié

  • Des notions ou une expérience passée dans la vente indirecte sont un plus

 

🛠️ Compétences et outils

  • Une forte appétence pour la collaboration avec les équipes Tech et Product, au-delà de la simple remontée de demandes clients

  • Une grande agilité avec les outils numériques, l’IA et les automatisations, associée à une utilisation rigoureuse de notre OS interne. Tu comprends l’importance de la data pour une approche méthodique

  • Une curiosité réelle pour les métiers de la paie et les enjeux des cabinets, avec l’envie de monter en compétence sur un produit à forte profondeur métier

 

💎 Qualités

  • Autonomie, proactivité et esprit collectif : tu avances sur tes objectifs tout en contribuant à la vie de l’équipe

  • Le goût du terrain et l’envie de développer un portefeuille exclusivement parisien, avec des rencontres locales

  • Data-driven et pragmatique : nous prenons des décisions basées sur des métriques précises et métier

  • Clarté, curiosité et esprit de coopération pour travailler avec les équipes et les cabinets

 
 

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Premier entretien avec Maxime, Head of Sales 1h

2️⃣ Business case à partir de situations réelles avec Tancrède (CEO), Alexandre (Déploiement & Accompagnement) et Maxime - en présentiel 📍

3️⃣ Approfondissement métier et motivations avec Alexandre (Partner Success) et Maxime 1h

4️⃣ Prises de références

5️⃣ Rencontre avec l’équipe dans nos bureaux, en présentiel 1h

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission au contact du terrain et du produit

Un rôle commercial full cycle au contact des cabinets, du produit et de l’équipe, pour accompagner la croissance d’Alassio sur Paris exclusivement, sans tournées régionales.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Rémunération compétitive + BSPCE

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🍽️ Carte Swile (tickets restaurant)

  • 💻 Matériel de pointe (MacOS, écran incurvé)

  • 🏝️ RTT

jobs.title: Founding Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations !

 
 

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots

En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :

  • ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ;

  • c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle.

Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies.

C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché, au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :

  • une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises ;

  • l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc. ;

  • la valorisation des données de paie et sociales, pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…

L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH.

 

🚀 Tes responsabilités

Ta mission est de concevoir et faire vivre les systèmes de fonctionnement d'Alassio. Concrètement, tu identifies partout dans l'entreprise ce qui empêche les équipes de travailler à l'échelle (un process défaillant ou absent, un passage de relais flou, une information introuvable, une tâche répétitive que personne n'a pris le temps d'automatiser) et tu le résous de bout en bout : un diagnostic précis, puis un cahier des charges documenté et actionnable, puis l'accompagnement de sa mise en œuvre jusqu'à son adoption effective par les équipes. Une solution que personne n'utilise n'est pas une solution.

Tes leviers sont aussi bien managériaux (formalisme interne, rituels, répartition des responsabilités) que produit et techniques (modèle de données, outillage, automatisation des flux de travail), avec un parti pris constant : « Just build it ». Tu mettras en place, avec les équipes concernées, des solutions actionnables et des systèmes qui tournent.

 

🧭 Tes premiers chantiers

Pour te donner une idée concrète, voici le type de chantiers que tu pourrais mener dans tes six premiers mois :

  1. Bâtir un réseau national de formateurs et d'intégrateurs certifiés, pour permettre aux cabinets de se former partout en France sans saturer nos équipes à chaque pic de déploiement : modèle économique et tarification, maillage du territoire avec les Sales, parcours de certification et suivi qualité avec l'équipe DnA (Déploiement & Accompagnement), cadre contractuel, et circuit de remontée des demandes des cabinets vers le support et le Product. En bref, tu contribueras à mettre sur pied une place de marché d'intégrateurs et de formateurs Alassio.

  2. Fluidifier le parcours d'un cabinet, de la signature à la production : formaliser les passages de relais entre les squads Sales, DnA, Métier & Juridique et Tech (ce qui est transmis, dans quel outil, dans quel délai, et qui tranche en cas de blocage). Ce travail se traduit par la mise en place de workflows au sein de Bedrock, notre OS interne : il rend l'ensemble du contexte d'Alassio interrogeable et permet de transformer quasi instantanément une solution que tu as formalisée en gain concret pour toute l'équipe.

  3. Améliorer en profondeur, en coordination étroite avec l'AI Engineer, notre OS Bedrock pour en faire le réflexe par défaut de toutes les équipes : identifier les cas d'usage transverses à plus fort impact, structurer le contexte métier qui alimente l'OS, travailler sur l'hébergement et la dimension collaborative, mettre en place des workflows d'agents déclenchés par événement, tenir à jour le catalogue des commandes, et mettre en place le suivi qui mesure la performance et l'adoption.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans des rôles opérationnels (GTM, Ops) ou en conseil en stratégie, idéalement avec une dimension technique, dans des contextes où tu as vu la structure d'une équipe évoluer vite (par exemple une scale-up, ou une refonte organisationnelle chez des clients en conseil)

  • Une compréhension fine des goulots d'étranglement organisationnels et informationnels qui ralentissent les entreprises à mesure qu'elles grandissent, et des transformations que l'IA est en train d'y opérer

  • Le goût des défis techniques et un esprit très analytique, sans perdre ton profil généraliste : tes expériences t'ont amené(e) à croiser les expertises, entre commercial et technique, produit et métier

 

💎 Qualités

  • Un goût pour l'optimisation et l'organisation : tu aimes que les choses soient claires, que l'information soit facile à mobiliser, propre et maintenable, et tu prends plaisir à produire vite des éléments actionnables

  • Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic

  • Penser à l'échelle : tu conçois dès le départ des solutions capables d'encaisser des montées en charge ×10 ou ×100, tout en restant pragmatique sur ce qui compte à court et moyen terme

 
 

Processus de sélection

  2. Étude de cas à partir de situations réelles, à dominante métier, avec Tancrède, Maxime (Head of Sales) et Alexandre (Responsable DnA) : 1 h30

  3. Étude de cas à partir de situations réelles, à dominante technique, avec Hector (COO) et Paul Rousseau (Founding SWE) : 1 h30

  4. Rencontre informelle de l'équipe dans nos bureaux, puis échange séparé avec les fondateurs

  5. Deux à troise prises de référence

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Tu rejoins une aventure entrepreneuriale en plein passage à l'échelle, sur un marché verrouillé depuis des années. Notre conviction : les bons process libèrent les équipes, les mauvais les étouffent. Ton rôle est précisément de concevoir les premiers, pour que chaque équipe d'Alassio aille plus vite, avec l'ambition assumée de bâtir une référence en matière d'organisation nativement construite autour de l'IA.

Le poste a vocation à grandir avec l'entreprise : selon tes envies et ce que tu auras construit, il pourra évoluer vers la direction des opérations, la structuration d'une nouvelle fonction ou le lancement d'une nouvelle activité.

Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges.   • Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. 

  • Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications.

(Senior) Product Marketing Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Location: Zaltbommel, Netherlands (Hybrid)

Reporting to: VP of Marketing


About Cyclomedia & The Role

Cyclomedia creates digital representations of the real world, giving professionals the visual data they need to manage assets and infrastructure. We are currently sharpening our commercial strategy. To drive this, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the market.

In our setup, Product Management builds the solution, and Product Marketing wins the market. As part of the Marketing department, you keep our messaging strictly focused on customer value. You own the value propositions, the customer context, and the commercial message. Your output forms the foundation for all our demand generation campaigns.

The Role & Collaboration

As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management. Armed with this market reality, you brief our Regional Marketing Managers and Content Marketers on the target audiences, messaging, and commercial hooks required for their campaigns. You also work with our Sales Enablement team to ensure sales representatives have the materials they need to close deals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Positioning & Messaging: Translate technical product capabilities into clear positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive pipeline value and improve lead conversion rates.

  • Market Intelligence: Feed the product roadmap with market insights, buyer needs, and competitive intelligence.

  • Sales Alignment: Validate marketing materials with regional sales teams so they are fully equipped to sell the solution.

  • First 6 Months Impact: Work out the context for our top 6 value propositions and produce the foundational global marketing materials to guide upcoming demand and lead generation campaigns.

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years of Product Marketing experience, or a strong commercial background deeply embedded in our core markets.

  • Domain Expertise (Preferred): A background in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or mobile mapping, or specific industry experience in utility companies, telecom network planning, public or network asset management, or engineering work planning.

  • Commercial Acumen: A proven ability to look from the outside in. You base your strategies on what the buyer needs to hear rather than what the product can do.

  • Ownership: You work independently and possess the maturity to help shape the Product Marketing function as we grow.

What We Offer

  • Room to make your mark: A challenging role in a strong, growing international company, with real freedom to shape the position.

  • A great team to join: A small, close-knit and growing marketing team, plus experienced colleagues to build on.

  • A competitive package: An attractive base salary and an 8.3% annual bonus scheme.

  • Growth: Training, online courses and (team) coaching to support your development.

  • Time off: 25 holidays, the option to buy up to 10 extra days a year, and an extra day off after Ascension Day.

  • Wellbeing: A flexible Mental Health Day each year to rest and recharge, and a sports allowance of €25 gross per month.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office and 2 from home, with a home-working allowance of €2 per day.

  • The right tools: A company phone and laptop.

jobs.title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

jobs.title: Field Sales Account Executive
jobs.description:
Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. 

Your responsibilities:

  • Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)

  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 

  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market

What you will bring to the team: 

  • Dutch fluency is a must 

  • Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry

  • Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory 

  • Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels

  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment

  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

  • General technical proficiency with software

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus

What’s in it for you?

Come Live the Lightspeed Experience….

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding.

  • Uncapped commission

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow

  • Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office 

  • Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

jobs.description:
De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord.

Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA). Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds;

  • Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten;

  • Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model;

  • Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren.


Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je:

  • Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar;

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL;

  • Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum;

  • Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren;

  • Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen;

  • Pré: 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.000,- en € 5.400,- bruto per maand (naar kennis en ervaring), plus laptop en telefoon van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld, een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Ruimte om te ondernemen: een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen;

  • Hybride werken vanuit ons Basecamp in Rotterdam (bij fulltime 3 dagen kantoor, 2 thuis): een moderne werkomgeving met uitzicht over de Waterweg, een inhouse gym, restaurant en de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen;

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.description:
Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

  • Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

  • Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

  • In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

  • Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

  • Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

  • Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software.

  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen.

  • Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract.

  • Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

  • Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen.

  • Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting.

  • Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager.

  • Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

  • Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling.

  • Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag.

MEER WETEN?

Internship - UAV Robotics/Mechatronics (Drone Prototyping, Integration & Field Testing)
jobs.description:
Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP


Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

If you’ve ever spent a weekend building a drone, tuning a flight controller, soldering a power harness, or figuring out why your FPV setup won’t arm, this internship is literally designed for you.

We’re looking for a hands-on builder who loves working with real hardware:

  • wiring sensors

  • mounting compute boards

  • setting up flight controllers

  • testing drones outdoors

  • fixing whatever breaks and making it better

If phrases like ArduPilot, PX4, Jetson, ESCs, power distribution, 3D printing, or FPV gear make you smile, you’re the kind of person we want.

This is not a “sit behind a desk” internship. You will be on the drones. You will be in the field. You will fly.


What you’ll do

  • Build and integrate hardware onto real drone platforms used in active R&D.

  • Work hands-on with flight controllers (ArduPilot) and compute boards (Jetson, Orange Pi).

  • Deploy and debug embedded perception software.

  • Solder, assemble, and prototype wiring, adapters, mounts, and housings.

  • 3D-print parts and quickly turn ideas into working physical prototypes.

  • Support and participate in drone flight tests (you’ll fly regularly).

  • Troubleshoot issues, iterate fast, and improve our hardware setups.

You’ll see your work fly, literally!


Who you are

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

 

The Role:

 

We are looking for a Senior Business Central Developer on behalf of our client to lead the technical design, development, and customization of core Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central solutions. In this role, you will take operational ownership of complex ERP extensions—architecting robust AL codebases, integrating third-party systems via web services, and optimizing database performance across multi-tenant cloud environments.

 

What we are looking for:

 

  • 5+ years of dedicated software development experience with Dynamics 365 Business Central (and legacy Dynamics NAV), featuring expert-level proficiency in AL language, custom page/report extensions, codeunits, and event subscribers.

  • Strong functional and technical command of standard Business Central modules, including Finance (GL, AP, AR), Supply Chain, Inventory, Purchasing, and Sales.

  • Extensive experience connecting Business Central with external systems, CRMs, and e-commerce platforms using RESTful web services, OData, JSON, and OAuth2 authentication.

  • Daily practice authoring automated unit and integration tests using the AL Test Framework, utilizing test isolation and mocks to ensure upgrade stability.

  • Proven experience maintaining source code, versioning, and automated build pipelines using GitHub Actions, AL Go for GitHub, or Azure DevOps.

  • Deep understanding of SQL Server fundamentals, Business Central telemetry, index tuning, and performance profiling to eliminate lockups and slow-running queries.

 

Nice-to-have:

 

  • Practical experience navigating Microsoft AppSource validation workflows and technical compliance checks.

  • Familiarity with the broader Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and Dataverse synchronization.

  • Exposure to Azure cloud services (Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Key Vault).

  • Background in migrating legacy C/AL codebases (Dynamics NAV) to modern AL extensions.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable Business Central extensions in AL using event-driven architectures to customize ERP business logic cleanly.

  • Architect secure web service integrations between Business Central and external applications (ERPs, CRMs, banking networks, e-commerce storefronts).

  • Analyze system logs and telemetry using Business Central performance profilers and Application Insights to resolve locking, slow requests, and resource bottlenecks.

  • Establish and manage automated build, test, and release workflows using GitHub Actions and AL Go across development, staging, and production environments.

  • Enforce strict coding standards, conduct peer code reviews, and ensure codebases strictly adhere to Microsoft's technical guidelines for cloud upgrades and AppSource publication.

 

What we offer:

 

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.

 

Predictable project hours

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

 

Flex days, so you can recharge

Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.

 

Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies

Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies.

 

Hand-picked opportunities, just for you

Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.

 

One seamless process, multiple opportunities

A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.

 

Compensation

Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (No Experience Required) - Japanese and English
jobs.description:
For thousands of years, maps have provided humans with the knowledge they need to make decisions. As a Maps Evaluator, you will have the opportunity to provide ground truth for your town, city or country.

 

At Peroptyx, we are looking for Data Analysts who will review mapping data for digital mapping applications. Your research capabilities will validate and ensure that the navigation of certain routes are accurate and safe.

 

As part of this role you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.

 

With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. The flexibility of our roles minimizes the impact on your daily routine.

 

So, whether you are a student looking to earn as you learn, a retiree looking for a new challenge, a part-time/full time professional or a work from home parent, Peroptyx has the right role for you!

 

Benefits

  • Work up to 20 hours per week.

  • Earn a competitive rate of pay.

  • Develop your research skills.

  • Avoid the long commute.

  • Work from the comfort of your home office.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of setting your own working hours!

 

Ideal Candidate

  • Fluent in English and Japanese.

  • Excellent research skills.

  • Excellent local knowledge of your home country.

  • Good understanding and general knowledge of the geography and culture of Japan.

  • Analytical mindset.

 

Job Requirements

  • Must be living in Japan for a minimum of 5 consecutive years.

  • Must pass an online open-book exam that can verify your full understanding of the material and concepts.

  • Must be willing to work a minimum of 10 hours and up to 20 hours per week depending on task availability.

  • Good working knowledge of search engines, map applications and familiarity with social media platforms.

  • Strong ability to learn, understand and apply multiple sets of different instructions.

  • All work must be of an independent nature.

 

Apply Online Today!
